en: Black‑and‑white image of a woman in traditional Northern European folk costume standing in a wooden interior. She wears a long striped skirt with an additional striped apron, a fitted vest over a white blouse with full sleeves, stockings and simple black shoes, and a folk-style cap or headscarf. She stands in profile, touching the carved upper frame of a heavy wooden door with ornate panels and decorative friezes; behind her are richly carved wooden walls and plank flooring, suggesting the interior of an old rural house or historic building.
